newsitem.title: USA: Business investigative firm opens Hartford office.
newsitem.headline: Business investigative firm opens Hartford office.

text.p: Corporate investigative and business intelligence firm Decision Strategies International Inc said Tuesday it opened an office in Hartford to serve clients in New England.
The company said there was growing demand by law firms, financial institutions, insurance companies and state agencies for sophisticated investigations.

Decision Strategies provides specialized information and intelligence services, investigative due diligence, risk management and security services, compliance and ethics program development, monitoring services and the protection of intellectual property.
The Hartford office will also offer environmental liability investigations to insurance companies, and anti-money laundering and anti-fraud programs to banks.
The company recently served as independent investigator in the Texaco Inc race discrimination case.
